title: Gideon and the Signal
author: G. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Rafael Almeida, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
